[[Overseer]] |TV actor =[[Nina Kassa]] }} '''Sarah Clements''' is an employee of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Sarah Clements was a Vault-Tec employee who worked in and around [[Hollywood]]. She and [[George Yaffe]] received [[the Ghoul|Cooper Howard]], a famous actor, at a Hollywood studio when he was convinced to film an advertisement for Vault-Tec on the urging of his wife [[Barb Howard|Barb]], one of the company's executives. Cooper told them that he had never filmed any ads before this one, which George and Sarah laughed off. Later, after Cooper put on a [[Vault jumpsuit]] for the ad, he asked them if it was protective against radiation. Barb gave George and Sarah a side-eye, and they hesitated before Sarah claimed that the jumpsuit did, in fact, do so. They proceeded to watch Cooper pose for the ad.{{FOTV|1|3}} ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Head]]=== Sarah is seen talking with her colleague George as Barb talks to her husband about how dapper dressed he is and if he's ready to meet the "suits". When Cooper walks toward them, he shakes both of their hands, and Sarah cordially thanks Cooper on behalf of the whole Vault-Tec family, mentioning how delighted they are that Barb used her connections to get him. The '''scavengers''' are a group of denizens of [[Filly]] {{In|FOTV}}. 

==Background==
This group of six scavengers is led by [[Tom (TV series)|Tom]] and includes the [[Filly huge man|huge man]] and four others.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Head]]===
[[File:FOTV Scavengers.png|thumb|200px|Scavengers at work]]
The scavengers find the unguarded power armor that [[Maximus]] left on the outskirts of Filly. When Maximus returns and tries to recover the armor, two scavengers run off, while four others (the leader named Tom, the huge man, a masked man, and a long-haired man) decide to fight him for it. After initially beating Maximus into the ground, the group loses interest in him, with Tom warning him not to contest them again.

Maximus does not back down and instead picks up a wrench and a toilet seat as weapons, going back for round two. He beats the huge man and the masked man unconscious, but Tom and the other man grapple him against his power armor; however, Maximus manages to put his left arm inside the power armor, using it to hold and crush Tom's head, killing him. The long-haired man runs away in fright, leaving Maximus victorious.

==Appearances==
The scavengers appear {{In|FOTV}}.

And for those of us who can successfully embrace that, I'd say the future is golden.|Sebastian to [[Cooper Howard]]}} '''Sebastian Leslie''' is an actor from the pre-[[Great War|War]] era {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== By the 2070s, Sebastian Leslie had made a name for himself as an actor in [[Hollywood]], where he played a character named Bartholomew Codsworth. He also became acquainted with, and later counted as a friend by, [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]]. Sebastian would eventually sell the rights to use his voice to [[General Atomics International]], who incorporated it into their [[Mister Handy (TV series)|Mister Handy]] line of robots, paying him [[Pre-War money|$]]186,000 (pre-tax). His agent managed to negotiate the inclusion of a personal Mister Handy for Sebastian. However, he later expressed to Cooper that it felt awkward to hear his own voice speaking as a servant in his home.{{FOTV|1|6}}
